project_type: React CRM SPA with TanStack Router/Start, deployed on Cloudflare Workers
build_system: Vite + Bun, Cloudflare Workers deployment via Wrangler
test_framework: No unit test framework; relies on TypeScript checking + ESLint + production build
verification_instructions: 1. Run `bunx tsc --noEmit` - must pass with zero errors. 2. Run `bun run build` - must produce dist/ successfully.
environment_constraints: No unit test runner. Verification is TypeScript typecheck + production build. Network available for package installs.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing code patterns. Use cn() from @/lib/utils for conditional classes. Use lucide-react icons. Use shadcn/ui Dialog components.
key_patterns: The EmailComposeDialog in leads/$id.tsx is the reference pattern for expandable compose. Key features: flex flex-col layout with min-h-0, localStorage persistence of expanded state, Maximize2/Minimize2 toggle button, conditional sizing classes via cn(). Templates are simple objects with id/label, and a buildTemplate function returns {subject, body}.
directory_structure: src/routes/_authenticated/ contains page components. src/components/ui/ has shadcn components. src/lib/ has utilities.
